name: print-social-yellow-and-orange-marketing-agency-post-with-strategy-checklist
title: 'We are Creative Digital Marketing Agency' post with yellow and white rounded panels and an orange strategy checklist
whatItIs: A square light grey post with a mustard rounded panel carrying a white script 'We are Creative' over condensed black 'DIGITAL MARKETING AGENCY' and a script quote, a white rounded panel behind a smiling woman holding a coffee, an orange 'Our Strategy' checklist box, a yellow logo pill and a dark contact bar.
whatItMeans: Warm and credible; layered rounded panels and a checklist feel organised and friendly.
techniques: Layer two rounded panels in different colours behind the subject.
Pair condensed caps with script accents.
Show services as a ticked checklist box.
Anchor contacts in a dark bottom bar.

vocabulary.definition: A block listing items with ticks.
